PockPock Agent 0.2.13 shows what the agent plans and does, action by action. Each plan step lists the small actions the agent will take, and every action shows the tool, the command and the result. Questions come in one dialog with one **Submit**. The installer no longer stops with "cannot be closed", and it asks whether to repair or do a clean install.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.12 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. Your chats, settings, models and caches are kept. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.12

### See every action

- **Plans list small actions under each step.** For example: "Write index.html with header, hero, menu preview and footer" and "Link styles.css and script.js". The agent is given the same actions when it runs. With **Plan in steps**, each step shows the tools it may use and how it is checked.
- **Every action shows its tool and command.** Each line in the step list shows the tool and what it ran or worked on, for example `exec` with `npm.cmd test`, or `write` with `menu.html`.
- **Details** shows the inputs, the result, the exit code, how long it took, the folder and, for file changes, the change itself.
- Passwords, keys and tokens are hidden, and file contents are shown by size. The step list now starts open.

### Questions in one dialog

- When the agent has questions before it runs, a dialog opens with one question per page. Pick a suggested answer or type your own, move with **Back** and **Next**, and send all of them with the one **Submit answers** button on the last page.
- Questions you leave empty are left to the agent. Closing the dialog keeps your answers; **Answer questions** on the plan opens it again.
- The task is planned again once with all your answers, instead of once per answer.

### One Retry, one Report

- A failed PockPock Agent task shows **Retry from step** and **Report** only on its failed card. A failed Chat or OpenClaw reply shows them only in the bar at the top. Before, they appeared in up to three places.
- "Finished steps" now counts plan steps, so the bar and the card agree. Before, the bar could say "54 finished steps" for a 7-step plan.

### Installing by hand (Windows)

- **No more "PockPock Agent cannot be closed".** PockPock's background services kept running after the app closed and held files the installer needed to replace. The installer now stops them first; they start again with the app. Ollama and OpenClaw are not affected.
- **Repair or clean install.** If PockPock is already on the PC, the installer asks:
  - **Yes: Repair** keeps the caches and replaces the app.
  - **No: Clean install** removes the caches (browser caches and old update downloads) and installs fresh.
  - **Cancel** does not install.

  Your chats, settings, keys and models are kept either way. Updating from inside the app does not ask.

## Good to know

- Every pull request in this release passed the full check suite (backend tests and desktop typecheck and build on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS), and the changes were also tested together before release.
- The OpenClaw command and result details follow what a real OpenClaw turn sent.
- Not tested yet: a full manual install clicking through **Repair** and **Clean install**, and a real model writing the small actions under each step.
- Help is in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki). Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
